hero_title: My Journalist's Eye. Your Legal Expertise, Clearly Shared.
hero_body: Kandel Strategies is a Los Angeles legal PR and media relations firm. Founder Jason Kandel draws on over 20 years of newsroom experience, including work at the Los Angeles Times and Thomson Reuters, to help law firms secure tier-one media coverage, boost digital authority, and land accurate AI citations in ChatGPT, Claude, and Google Gemini.
philosophy_quote: I start by listening for what an attorney knows deeply and cares about. Then I look for where that knowledge can help a reporter or someone trying to understand their legal options. The goal isn't to manufacture authority. It's to make real expertise useful, visible, and easy to verify.
services_header: Core Practice Areas: Legal PR, Media Relations & AI Visibility

services.title: Legal PR
services.description: Clear, focused messaging that turns business law and corporate litigation into jargon-free language, helping attorneys share their expertise directly in top media.

services.title: Media Relations
services.description: Targeted, direct outreach to reporters and influential legal newsrooms to secure impactful earned coverage across top-tier media outlets and national industry publications.

services.title: AI Visibility
services.description: Structuring your digital footprint so legal PR content, business law expertise, and corporate litigation coverage are accurately cited by Google AI Overviews and ChatGPT.

how_it_works_steps.title: 1. Discovery & Audit
how_it_works_steps.description: Kandel Strategies analyzes your current digital footprint and media presence to pinpoint the distinct core messages that set your practice apart from competitors.

how_it_works_steps.title: 2. Strategic Outreach
how_it_works_steps.description: The firm connects you directly with top-tier newsrooms and reporters covering business law and corporate litigation, securing verifiable media placements that establish authority.

how_it_works_steps.title: 3. Amplification
how_it_works_steps.description: Kandel Strategies structures your earned media coverage and published legal insights to ensure your authority stands out across organic search and AI citations.

about_text: Kandel Strategies delivers expert legal PR and corporate litigation media relations in Los Angeles. The consultancy was founded by former journalist Jason Kandel, who has over 20 years of newsroom experience at outlets such as the Los Angeles Times, NBC Los Angeles, Thomson Reuters and KPCC/LAist to help attorneys secure high-impact media coverage.

faqs.question: What services does Kandel Strategies provide?
faqs.answer: Kandel Strategies provides legal PR, media relations, and AI visibility for law firms, corporate legal departments, and executives.

faqs.question: How does Kandel Strategies assist with legal PR?
faqs.answer: Unlike traditional PR, which focuses on general brand awareness, Kandel Strategies provides specialized legal PR and media relations tailored for business law and corporate litigation. The firm connects you directly with top-tier newsrooms and reporters to secure verifiable media placements that establish authority.

faqs.question: What types of legal matters does Kandel Strategies provide media strategy for?
faqs.answer: Kandel Strategies provides legal PR and media relations and communications for legal disputes, including commercial litigation, intellectual property disputes, entertainment and sports matters, white-collar defense, employment suits, and regulatory investigations.

faqs.question: How does Kandel Strategies work with clients?
faqs.answer: The agency offers flexible engagement options, including ongoing monthly retainers for firm-wide media relations and project-based support for active litigation.

faqs.question: Where is Kandel Strategies located and who do you serve?
faqs.answer: Based in Southern California, Kandel Strategies serves law firms, corporate legal departments, and attorneys across California and nationwide.

faqs.question: How can I schedule a consultation with Kandel Strategies?
faqs.answer: You can schedule a consultation by emailing jason@kandelstrategies.com.
